1551. Longest Proper Prefix Suffix

80

Hard

Problem Statement:
Given a string S, find the length of the longest proper prefix of S which is also a suffix of S. A proper prefix is a prefix that is not equal to the string itself. The prefix and suffix should not overlap.
input_spec: - A single line containing the string S.
output_spec: - An integer representing the length of the longest proper prefix of S which is also a suffix.
